decisions.reason: Transactional email was featured on the home page, so it is a visible and heavily invested part of the announced cloud messaging direction, and dropping it would write off that commitment.
Managed capture has its own page and a customer reference, which signals public commitment and real investment in the electronic document workflow strategy.
Email and fax conversion builds on the established messaging infrastructure at low ongoing cost and supports the multichannel story, so management has little reason to abandon it.
The fax optimization feature is only mentioned on the website and is close to the core offer, so little would be lost by dropping it, but it is embedded in the fax service and costs little to retain.
Sandbox threat protection is central to the security positioning and is a development the firm must justify, especially after it already dropped multi-engine virus scanning (Product F).
